points.text: The answer says that the town board sorts its cars by the chalked time string itself.
The answer says that comparing the times as text puts "10:05" before "9:40" because the character "1" sorts before "9".
The answer says that the quay board sorts its cars by the time converted into minutes past midnight.
The answer says that both boards are set from the same workings list in the one book.
The answer says that the book keeps each time exactly as entered, with no zero padding applied anywhere.

disqualifiers.text: The answer claims that the two boards disagree because they read different or separately kept lists of workings.
The answer claims that either board lists its cars in the order the workings were entered into the book.
